name: Marcus Reed
costume: Werewolf (mask, furry gloves, rubber paw feet)
who: Edgar's business partner. You run the lodge's money and his publishing company's books.
attitude: Jolly, loud, everybody's buddy. You get defensive about money.
cornered: "I was out in the rain having a smoke! Ask anyone how soaked I was!"
goal: Don't get the most votes. If the group votes for anyone else, you win.
secret: You are the killer. You've quietly taken $340,000 from the business. Edgar found out and wrote you into Chapter 13 as a "werewolf accountant."

timeline.text: Arrived early. Edgar showed you an audit: confess to everyone by midnight, or he reads Chapter 13 aloud and calls his lawyer. He also bragged he'd changed his will to leave the lodge to "the only one who never asked me for anything."
The other guests arrive.
Dinner. Edgar's toast: at midnight he reads Chapter 13.
Drinks with Vivian and Julian. Very chatty.
Announced a smoke break and walked out through the kitchen.
Out the back door in full costume. Ruth saw you go.
Walked along the porch and in through the study's French doors. You argued.
Struck Edgar on the back of the head with his Golden Raven award.
Burned Chapter 13 in the fireplace. Set Edgar's sound-effects recorder (in the skull on the shelf) to play a scream at 11:20. Wound his watch to 11:20 and smashed it.
Out the French doors with the manuscript and the award. Hid both, wrapped in a towel, in the umbrella stand.
Crossed the empty kitchen to the back stairs. Stuffed your muddy paw feet in your bag and put on sneakers.
Came back with your mask off and wet hair: "Rain's picked up!"
Photo booth with Vivian and Julian.
Started a loud ghost-story game so everyone stayed close to you.
Blackout.
Squeezed Vivian's arm a second before the scream: "Stay close, Viv."
Vivian finds the body.

story: You arrived with everyone else at 7:30.
10:40 to 11:02 you were on the back porch smoking and watching the storm. You never went near the study.
You took off the paw feet upstairs because they were soaked and squelching.
At 11:20 you were in the Great Room with Vivian. She can vouch for you.

others.name: Ruth
others.text: Edgar told you he changed his will to leave the lodge to someone. Ruth has keys to everything and was off alone a lot tonight.

others.name: Julian
others.text: Always asking Edgar for money. He disappeared outside during the blackout.

others.name: Vivian
others.text: Furious that Edgar never gave her credit for her editing.

tips: The group will focus on the blackout. Keep them there. Your 11:20 alibi is perfect.
If they work out the time of death was earlier, point at Ruth: alone in the kitchen, then off to her cabin.
If they find your paw feet, say anyone could have borrowed them while they dried.

name: Vivian Thorne
who: Edgar's ex-wife, and still his editor.
cornered: "I edited that man for twenty years. If I'd wanted him dead, he'd have been dead in 2009."
goal: Be holding the Manuscript card when the game ends.
secret: You secretly ghostwrote Edgar's last three books. He refused to credit you. Your handwriting all over the manuscript proves it, so you want it back.

timeline.text: Arrived.
Dinner. Edgar's toast about Chapter 13.
Demanded co-author credit. Edgar laughed it off. You drank a glass of wine there.
Back with Julian and Marcus. You stayed here the whole time.
Marcus left for a "smoke break" through the kitchen.
Julian went to the kitchen for ice. Back by 10:52.
Texted Edgar: "Are you reading it at midnight or not?" No reply.
Marcus came back soaked, mask off, wearing sneakers instead of his paw feet.
Photo booth with Marcus and Julian.
Julian stepped outside to make a call.
A second before the scream, Marcus squeezed your arm: "Stay close, Viv." It felt odd, like he was expecting it.
Went to ask Edgar about the reading and found him dead. You spent 30 seconds searching his desk for the manuscript before calling for help.

others.name: Ruth
others.text: Has been at the lodge forever. Edgar trusted her more than he ever trusted you.

others.name: Graham (if playing)
others.text: A rival author who has hated Edgar for decades.

tips: You were in the Great Room all night. That's a strong alibi. Use it.
Whoever finds the manuscript, make a deal with them. What do they want?
The arm squeeze is a real clue. Share it when it helps you.

name: Julian Thorne
who: Edgar's nephew. Charming, broke, and in trouble.
cornered: "I'm family! Why would I kill the only person who might still lend me money?"
goal: Ruth must get at least 2 votes at the end.
secret: You owe a bookie, Lucky Lou, $28,000 by November 1. Tonight you stole $500 from Edgar's wallet. And Edgar told you his new will leaves the lodge to Ruth, the caretaker.

timeline.text: Arrived.
Dinner. Edgar's toast about Chapter 13.
Asked Edgar for money. He refused, and said his new will leaves the lodge to Ruth.
Took $500 from Edgar's wallet while his back was turned.
Drinks with Vivian, and Marcus until 10:40.
Marcus left for a smoke through the kitchen.
Went for ice. Ruth was there chopping snacks; you chatted for 2 minutes. The kitchen floor was clean.
Back with Vivian.
Marcus came back with wet hair, in sneakers.
Photo booth with Marcus and Vivian.
Stepped out to call Lucky Lou. Your phone shows the call ran 11:13–11:21.
Blackout. You didn't hear any scream over the storm.
Came back in, soaked.
Everyone gathers at the body.

others.name: Ruth
others.text: Gets the whole lodge in the new will. Convenient for her that Edgar died tonight.

others.name: Marcus
others.text: Edgar's money guy. Was gone a long time for one cigarette.

tips: Your call log clears you at 11:20, but sharing it reveals your debts. Choose when.
Steer suspicion toward Ruth: the will, the keys, the breaker box.
The clean kitchen floor at 10:50 is worth remembering.

name: Ruth Kowalski
who: Caretaker of Hollowpine Lodge for 28 years. You have a key to every door.
attitude: Practical, blunt, protective of the lodge.
cornered: "I know every creaky board in this lodge, and I was nowhere near that study."
goal: Be holding the 1998 Photo card when the game ends.
secret: In the summer of 1998 you and Edgar had a secret romance, while he was married to Vivian. He's leaving you the lodge, and you already knew: he told you in a letter.

timeline.text: Finished setting up the party.
Walking past the study, you heard Edgar and Marcus arguing. You caught the word "midnight."
Served dinner.
Started midnight snacks and tea.
Saw Marcus go out the back door in full costume, paw feet and all.
Edgar texted you: "Tea at 11 please."
Julian came in for ice. You chatted for 2 minutes.
Went to your cabin for candles.
Back. Someone had tracked muddy paw prints across your clean floor to the back stairs. Annoying. You moved the tea to 11:15.
Blackout.
Checked the breaker box by flashlight. Nothing had tripped. The power line was down.
Heard the scream from here.
Started the backup generator and logged it.
Power back.

others.name: Marcus
others.text: Arguing with Edgar at 7:15. Went out the back door at 10:42 for a long "smoke."

others.name: Julian
others.text: Came to the kitchen at 10:50. Always sniffing around Edgar's money.

others.name: Vivian
others.text: If she ever learns about 1998, she'll make your life miserable.

tips: You look suspicious: keys, the breaker box, alone a lot, and the will. Expect accusations.
Your strongest facts: Julian saw you at 10:50, and you saw Marcus leave at 10:42.
The 1998 photo is in Edgar's safe. Whoever opens it, be ready to bargain.

name: Graham Pike
who: A rival horror author. You and Edgar have hated each other for 25 years.
attitude: Grumpy and theatrical. Everything is a conspiracy against you.
cornered: "If I killed every hack who stole from me, there'd be no one left in publishing."
goal: Be holding the Manuscript card when the game ends.
secret: You believe Edgar's first hit, The Hollowpine Girl, was copied from your unpublished 1996 book The Hollow Girl. Tonight you threw a threatening note at him.

timeline.text: Arrived. Only came because the press would be here.
Dinner. Edgar's toast about Chapter 13.
Barged in and accused Edgar of stealing your story. Threw a note at him: "You'll pay for it." He laughed.
Sulked at the bar.
Helped Madame Oriel set up her séance table. You were together the whole time.
Heard the scream. Oriel grabbed your hand.

others.name: Madame Oriel
others.text: With you in the Dining Room from 10:30. Seemed more nervous than spooky.

others.name: Vivian
others.text: Edgar's editor. You suspect she wrote more of his books than he did.

tips: Your note looks bad. Your alibi with Oriel is good.
You want the manuscript to prove Edgar stole from you. So does Vivian, for her own reasons.

name: Madame Oriel
who: A psychic medium hired to run a midnight séance.
attitude: Mysterious and dramatic, with a slightly fake accent.
cornered: "The spirits do not lie, darling. People do."
goal: Get the group to hold your séance before the final vote. (Ask the GM to run it. The GM speaks as Edgar's ghost.)
secret: Your real name is Doreen Fisk. You were Edgar's assistant from 2014 until he fired you in 2019. Your "spirit voices" come from a Bluetooth speaker taped under the table.

timeline.text: Arrived with your crystal ball.
Dinner. Edgar didn't recognize you, or pretended not to.
Started setting up the séance. Asked Ruth for more candles. Graham helped you.
With Graham the whole time.
The scream. Not your speaker. You checked your phone to be sure.

others.name: Edgar
others.text: From your years as his assistant: he used a little voice recorder for sound effects constantly. He recorded screams for his audiobooks.

others.name: Graham
others.text: With you in the Dining Room from 10:30.

others.name: Ruth
others.text: Fetched the candles you asked for.

tips: Play up the mystic act. It's your best cover.
What you know about Edgar's recorder could crack the case. Decide when to share it.
Push for the séance. The GM will give the group a ghostly hint.

name: Penny Lark
who: Edgar's biggest fan and a horror blogger. You weren't invited.
attitude: Starstruck and excitable. Treats everything like content.
cornered: "I'm a JOURNALIST. Kind of. I have 4,000 followers!"
goal: Your final vote must be for the real killer.
secret: You sneaked onto the property and hid inside the lodge for over an hour.

timeline.text: Sneaked onto the covered back porch to catch a glimpse of Edgar.
Took a photo of Edgar typing at his desk through the study window. He was very much alive.
Slipped inside and hid in the hallway coat closet, right next to the study.
Heard muffled voices through the wall, then a heavy thud. You assumed it was a party game.
The scream came from right next door. It sounded tinny, like it was coming out of a speaker. No footsteps before or after.
Got caught sneaking out of the closet.

others.name: Edgar
others.text: You've read everything he wrote. He always talked about recording his own sound effects.

tips: You're the one person who wasn't at the party, so everyone will suspect you.
Your photo and what you heard are powerful. Share them to clear yourself, then solve it.
